resources.name: MyKMHub working directory

resources.verify: Confirm the MyKMHub repository is listed.

resources.name: MyKMHub GitHub repository
resources.purpose: Durable remote source history and Vercel deployment source.

resources.verify: Confirm the latest production deployment uses the expected Git commit.

resources.name: MyKMHub domain settings
resources.verify: Confirm mykmhub.com is assigned and reports a valid configuration.

resources.name: MyKMHub Design System
resources.purpose: Approved foundations, components, patterns, and design decisions.
resources.verify: Check locally and on mykmhub.com after design-system changes.

resources.purpose: Select, modify, validate, and locally apply experimental themes.
resources.verify: Confirm presets persist and apply across routes in the current browser.

resources.name: Project specification
resources.purpose: Authoritative product direction, constraints, and decisions.
resources.verify: Review before changes that affect product scope or architecture.

resources.name: Project roadmap
resources.purpose: Future capabilities, priorities, and deferred work.
resources.verify: Update when a future concept is accepted, implemented, or retired.

resources.name: Operations and continuity guide
resources.purpose: Resume, test, publish, verify, and troubleshoot MyKMHub.
resources.verify: Follow the resume checklist after an extended break.

resources.name: Context-driven KM model
resources.purpose: Shared metadata, contextual views, and knowledge/action boundaries.
resources.verify: Test proposed facets against real records before extending them.
